intro: Converting years (yr) to days (d) is essential when translating measurements across project billing schedules, payroll timesheets, endurance race splits, and scientific interval logging. One year equals 365.2425 days, while one day equals 0.0027379 years. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many days are in 1 year?
faqs.answer: There are 365.2425 days (d) in 1 year (yr). To convert yr to d, use the exact conversion factor 365.2425.

faqs.question: How do I convert years to days manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your year value by 365.2425 (exact factor: 365.2425). For example, 12 yr × 365.2425 = 4,382.91 d.
